news.headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs released from jail; investigation ongoing
news.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs has been released from jail Wednesday amid an ongoing investigation following his arrest on several domestic violence charges.

news.headline: Packers' Jacobs arrested, faces several domestic violence charges
news.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs was arrested Tuesday and booked on several domestic violence charges, according to the Hobart-Lawrence (Wisconsin) Police Department.

news.headline: Source: Bucs RB Bucky Irving (shoulder) likely ready by summer
news.description: Buccaneers running back Bucky Irving, who is rehabbing from offseason shoulder surgery, should be ready later this summer, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

news.headline: Why Jayden Daniels' mental quickness sticks out to Dan Quinn
news.description: Commanders coach Dan Quinn explains what he has seen from Jayden Daniels in the QB's return from injury.

news.headline: What's next for Josh Jacobs after release from jail?
news.description: Ian Rapoport joins Pat McAfee and reports the latest on the Packers running back after he was released from jail

news.headline: Argentine police arrest suspects in U.S. athlete burglaries
news.description: Men suspected of being part of a transnational gang that orchestrated burglaries at the homes of well-known athletes, including stars from the NBA and NFL, have been arrested in Argentina.

news.headline: Patrick Mahomes back on field for Chiefs' first OTA practice
news.description: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes returned to the field with his teammates Tuesday for the first time since tearing the ACL and LCL in his left knee.

news.headline: McCarthy: No 'awkwardness' with Murray over QB1 competition
news.description: J.J. McCarthy says there isn't "any awkwardness" between him and Kyler Murray, whom the Vikings signed in March to compete for Minnesota's starting quarterback duties.

news.headline: Colts' Anthony Richardson vague on trade request, focused on job
news.description: Colts QB Anthony Richardson faces an uncertain future in Indianapolis and hasn't rescinded his recent trade request. But he's not letting any of that stand in the way of doing his job, he said Wednesday.

news.headline: Eagles' Jalen Hurts: Relationship with A.J. Brown 'really good'
news.description: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts said his relationship with A.J. Brown is "really good" despite all the trade talk that continues around the star receiver.
